subject: social_studies
concept: Evaluating a legal case or scenario to identify the strongest arguments on each side, without personally asserting which side is right
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's evenhandedness principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sorts arguments for a described legal scenario into two sides, each with genuine supporting reasoning
exercise.abstract: Student presents the strongest argument on each side of a described legal case

misconception_flags: presents one side of the case as a weak strawman rather than its strongest genuine form

interest_binding: case scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
